verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs explicitly claim auto-instrumentation of page views, clicks, and sessions 'out of the box' (amplitude-docs-4) and a wizard that auto-installs SDKs and fires a test event (amplitude-docs-1, amplitude-docs-27), directly matching the no-code tracking story. However, a hands-on community report states the opposite in practice: 'the integration is actually very hard, and the data in Amplitude is often wrong' (amplitude-comm-3), which concretely contradicts the ease-of-setup claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic form-interaction capture (only clicks/pageviews are named), and independent confirmation resolving the implementation-difficulty complaint.
